searchLog: Blocked again today, same failure mode as 2026-09-26: the network egress proxy allows only www.anthropic.com and rejects every ATS/job-board and company careers domain tested (api.ashbyhq.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.nvidia.com, databricks.com, stripe.com, apply.workable.com, ramp.com, linear.app, careers.microsoft.com, metacareers.com, www.google.com, alignment.anthropic.com — 13 domains tried, only the root anthropic.com domain resolved). The one reachable page (anthropic.com/careers/jobs) lists only Applied AI Architect and TPM openings, both already duplicates: Applied AI Architect was sent in a prior hunt and TPM is documented mid/senior-only in target-companies.json. Every individual Anthropic job link (including the Fellows Program posting) 307-redirects to job-boards.greenhouse.io, which is also blocked, so even that could not be verified from the real page. WebSearch surfaced two leads worth flagging for a future run once fetch access is restored: (1) Anthropic Fellows Program, January 2027 cohort, rolling applications per search snippets only (unverified) — but Dom was already rejected from this program's July 2026 cohort, so it would likely be excluded as already-attempted regardless; (2) Google's APM program historically reopens for the next cohort in a ~2-week window starting late September, which would be opening right about now, but google.com is blocked so the live page could not be checked. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output given zero fetchable job-board sources, not a quality judgment on the target-company list.
